After the commit https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/commit/2868a2793558353a912cd2d738c3a70bb4ef7dbf, ip command is no longer available in sonic-mgmt docker

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  Run sonic-mgmt dokcer and exec ip command

**Describe the results you received:**

```
johnar@e9444e101a63:~$ cat /etc/issue
Ubuntu 18.04.5 LTS \n \l

johnar@e9444e101a63:~$ ip
bash: ip: command not found
```

**Describe the results you expected:**

ip command should be available

**- Why I did it**
Fixes #5425 

**- How I did it**
Explicitly installed the `ip` command in the mgmt container. This seems to be a new requirement in the 18.04 docker image.

**- How to verify it**
Log into the built container and run `ip`, `ip addr`, `ip route`, `ip -6 addr`, etc.
